scope: The eighteenth-century palazzetto at 26 Piazza di Spagna, including its four-bay elevation along the Spanish Steps and the principal street-facing return.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla original of both bays on the adjoining Spanish Steps, taken in 2007 and released into the public domain by the photographer. The heritage wall, plaster panels, dark shutters, stone ornaments and roof room are visible.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed the exact 2007 image already on Qualla and its original photographer’s public-domain release. Open topography is used only for heights.
